published_source: Figures.do line 339: reghdfe log_hours_S F*event L*event if sample_C==1, a(id crawl_month) cluster(id); leads F1-F12 (evt_time = -1..-12), lags L0-L36 unbinned, omitted = evt_time < -12 and never-treated; event_plot trimmed to +/-12. Coefficients are reported only graphically; the authors' path re-run in Stata is in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.01820/authors_eventstudies.csv and in the replication log.
column: sample C panel, sub-panel (a) low-demand day
notes: Outcome: log hours to Shufersal's earliest delivery slot, Saturday crawl (low-demand day). sample_C: treated pre-entry competitive markets (compet==1) plus never-entered controls with market_size>2. gvar Ei = month of first rival entry (NA for never-entered controls). Authors normalise to the pooled bin evt_time < -12 (no -1 reference) and leave lags unbinned to +36 (max observed +31); run_spec.R uses reference -1, bins at -13 and 13, and averages 0..12 (post) and -12..-2 (pre). fixest reproduces the authors' coefficient path exactly (log).

event_structure.source: Programs/Figures.do lines 324-346: reghdfe log_hours_S F*event L*event if sample_C==1, a(id crawl_month) cluster(id); F`l'event = 1[evt_time == -l] for l = 1..12, L`l'event = 1[evt_time == l] for l = 0..36 (L32-L36 are empty in this sample, so the bins stop at 31); event months < -12 pooled with never-treated markets are the omitted category (article: 'Reference Period: More Than 12 Months Before Entry'); event_plot trims the figure to -12..12, so the reported bins are -12..-1 and 0..12. evt_time = crawl_month - Ei = rel on every treated row (months 679-714 consecutive; earliest entry 683, no pre-sample adopters).
event_structure.verified: fixest with this structure (es_assign) on the authors' sample reproduces the 25 exported reghdfe coefficients (F1-F12, L0-L12 in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.01820/authors_eventstudies.csv), max abs diff 8.72e-15 (SE 4.37e-13), N 1723 = reghdfe.

event_structure_vs_static_nov2: The Table 2 static specs drop event months -2/-1 (anticipation rule, onset Ei_shift2); this event spec keeps them as the reported lead bins -2 and -1 and, like the authors, normalizes to event months < -12 plus never-treated markets, so its pre summary includes the anticipation months.
